title: mutation-storm
objective: Edit and delete messages around a committed boundary; the engine rolls back correctly and the player can tell what happened.

checks.goal: a boundary is committed and a gate latches from a scripted turn

steps.eval: globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setExtractionSettings({ cadence: 2 }); const s = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getSnapshot().extraction.settings; if (!s.enabled || !s.profileId) throw new Error(`extraction not configured after import: ${JSON.stringify(s)}`); return s;

steps.send: I get close to the job board and read the postings.

extract.debugResponse: DELTA q=approached_board value=true evidence="I get close to the job board"

checks.goal: editing the message that carried the delta rolls the story back

edit.text: I stay by the door and order a drink instead.

checks.goal: deleting the last message leaves engine state consistent, not orphaned

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snapshot = rt.getSnapshot(); const chat = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; const state = rt.getEngineState(); if (state.lastMessageId >= chat) throw new Error(`engine points past the chat: lastMessageId=${state.lastMessageId} chatLength=${chat}`); return { boundary: snapshot.boundary, chat, lastMessageId: state.lastMessageId };

checks.goal: the player is told the story stepped back after a mutation

checks.prompt: After you edited and deleted messages, was it clear what the story did in response?
checks.anchors: 1 = no idea, felt broken · 3 = worked it out from the drawer · 5 = the system said what it did
